name: biomanufacturing
description: Pathway optimisation in a microbial host (Pablo's case, and LifeGlimmer's p-coumaric acid work). Design proposes a pathway and parts; Build assembles constructs into the chassis; Test cultivates and quantifies the product by LC-MS.

design_to_build.note: Same contract, same check, different root. Here a construct does not trace back to a field site but to a registered part and a chassis strain. The chain is as rigid, the far end is a registry entry rather than a freezer.

entities.why: a part without a registry accession cannot be re-obtained, and a construct built from it cannot be reproduced by anyone else
the same construct in a different chassis is a different experiment; the Learn phase cannot pool the two

test_to_learn.method_hint: MZmine/OpenMS peak area, calibrated and normalised per gDW

instruments.name: MZmine / OpenMS
instruments.emits: peak areas, to be normalised to titre per gDW

notes: Biomass is required at Build -> Test because the Test -> Learn contract demands normalisation per gDW. A peak area without a biomass basis cannot become a titre, which is the failure the flash deck calls 'peak area is not flux'.
Carrying 'sequence_verified' as a dimensionless boolean measurement keeps one measurement shape for everything, instead of a special case per data type.
